# Firmware Images

These are complete, merged images generated by `scripts/merge_firmware.py`:

| File | Target | Flash offset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `S021-ESP32-UserDemo-v0.1.0-<commit>(commit)-LHY-<YYYYMMDD>_0x0.bin` | ESP32 | `0x0` |
| `S021-ESP32S3-UserDemo-v0.1.0-<commit>(commit)-LHY-<YYYYMMDD>_0x0.bin` | ESP32-S3 | `0x0` |
| `S021-Web-UserDemo-v0.1.0-<commit>(commit)-LHY-<YYYYMMDD>.zip` | Static `web/` + `esp_web/` package | — |

Regenerate both:

```bash
pio run -e esp32 -e esp32s3
```

The filename is generated automatically:

```text
S021-<ARCH>-UserDemo-v<version>-<8-char commit>(commit)-LHY-<build date>_0x0.bin
S021-Web-UserDemo-v<version>-<8-char commit>(commit)-LHY-<build date>.zip
```

Each image already includes the bootloader, partition table, `boot_app0`, and application. Do not flash these files at `0x10000`; the merged image starts at `0x0`.

Verify the downloaded files:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```

The runtime board, display and external I2C pins are detected by M5Unified/M5GFX.
